sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach's strong underlying record (7 wins, 1 draw, 2 losses) keeps them in a commanding position. Alsager Town sit bottom with just 4 points from 10 games and arrive on poor form, making this a favorable fixture for the hosts to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town, offering an opportunity to close the gap on leaders Sandbach; Stafford have won their last outing despite recent inconsistency. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, visit Eccleshall (6th), a direct challenge in the mid-table battle. Wolverhampton Casuals (4th) travel to Wednesfield Community in a fixture between two sides in reasonable form. Bilston Town (6th) face Foley Meir at home in a battle between mid-table sides. New Mills, currently 8th, visit Market Drayton Town, who have won three of their last four and will look to continue that momentum. Barnton host Shawbury United, who are in a desperate run of six straight defeats and need points urgently. Crewe face Allscott Heath in a clash between lower-mid-table teams. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town, two struggling sides fighting for points. Brereton Social, bottom-half strugglers, host Widnes Town, who are in the division's worst form with just 2 points. Later in the week, Brereton Social face Wednesfield Community at home on Wednesday evening in a match between sides seeking improvement.
